title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electrostatic energy W.

title: Final Potential Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the potential at the center, phi(0).

title: Use of Gauss' Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Gauss' law to find the electric field inside the spherical shell.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up the integral for calculating the electrostatic energy.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for electric field and potential.

title: Charge Density Usage
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly incorporate the uniform charge density rho in their calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios to validate their results.
